An analysis of the company's financial profile reveals moderate creditworthiness: while the company exhibits a solid current ratio of 1.44 and an acceptable operating margin of 8%, its balance sheet carries a relatively high debt-to-equity ratio (total liabilities of $14.6B against equity of $7.58B) and negative retained earnings (-$398M), indicating historical losses or aggressive capital distributions. These leverage and accumulated deficit concerns are balanced by positive net income ($1.7B) and a substantial asset base, positioning the issuer at the lower end of the investment-grade spectrum. 

DECISION: BBB-
